ranks: Oracle EDHREC ranks 6820–6886 (the next 60 untriaged), and the cards waiting on mechanic:kindred-card-type, built this batch (the kindred card type, rule 308)

blocked.name: Lignify
blocked.why: the Kindred type is built; 'enchanted creature … loses all abilities' as a static isn't

blocked.name: Eldritch Immunity
blocked.why: the Kindred type is built; protection from each colour, and overloaded, isn't

blocked.name: Kozilek's Command
blocked.why: the Kindred type is built; 'target player scries X' isn't (scry has no target)

blocked.name: Not of This World
blocked.why: the Kindred type is built; 'counter target spell or ability that targets a permanent you control' and its target-keyed cost reduction aren't

blocked.name: Notorious Throng
blocked.why: the Kindred type is built; prowl isn't

blocked.name: Formless Genesis
blocked.why: the Kindred type is built; retrace isn't

blocked.name: Glistening Oil
blocked.why: The Aura's own upkeep trigger puts a -1/-1 counter on enchanted creature; no EffectTargetRef names an Aura's host (granting the trigger to the creature would make 'your upkeep' the creature controller's).

blocked.name: Mishra, Claimed by Gix
blocked.why: Its attack trigger melds it with Phyrexian Dragon Engine into Mishra, Lost to Phyrexia; meld isn't built.

blocked.name: Elrond, Master of Healing
blocked.why: No 'whenever you scry' trigger, nor X = the number of cards looked at while scrying.

blocked.name: Spider-Man, Brooklyn Visionary
blocked.why: Web-slinging (alternative cost returning a tapped creature you control) isn't built.

blocked.name: Vishgraz, the Doomhive
blocked.why: 'Gets +1/+1 for each poison counter your opponents have': grantPtPerCount.playerCounters reads only the controller's own counters.

blocked.name: Botanical Brawler
blocked.why: 'If it's the first time +1/+1 counters have been put on that permanent this turn' needs a per-permanent counters-put-this-turn record (counting puts before Brawler arrived, per the ruling).

blocked.name: Carth the Lion
blocked.why: 'Planeswalkers' loyalty abilities you activate cost an additional [+1]': abilityCostModification only changes mana/ninjutsu costs, not a loyalty cost (cumulative, applied once at payment per the rulings).

blocked.name: Hellish Rebuke
blocked.why: grant-triggered-all can grant the ability, but the granted trigger must fire only on damage to the player who cast Hellish Rebuke; a granted ability can't remember who granted it.

blocked.name: Slime Against Humanity
blocked.why: Deck validation exempts only basic lands from singleton, and no EffectAmount counts face-up cards you own in exile (countInGraveyard covers only graveyards).

blocked.name: Dreamtail Heron
blocked.why: Mutate isn't built.

blocked.name: Surge of Brilliance
blocked.why: castThisTurn's records are LKI snapshots without castFrom (castRecordOf runs before object.castFrom is set and takeLastKnown doesn't copy it), so 'spells cast this turn from anywhere other than your hand' can't be counted.

blocked.name: Goblin Cratermaker
blocked.why: A modal activated ability whose modes each bring their own target (chosen on activation, rule 700.2b) isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Guiltfeeder
blocked.why: No 'whenever this creature attacks and isn't blocked' trigger (only becomes-blocked / blocked-by).

blocked.name: Grothama, All-Devouring
blocked.why: Other creatures' granted attack trigger must fight Grothama (the static's source, not the trigger's), and the leave trigger needs damage dealt to Grothama this turn split by each source's controller.

blocked.name: The Belligerent
blocked.why: playFromLibraryTop/castFromLibraryTop/looksAtOwnLibraryTop are static-only; no one-shot 'until end of turn, you may look at the top card any time and play lands and cast spells from the top of your library' (player-effect has no such field).

blocked.name: Evie Frye
blocked.why: Partner with's 'target player may search' always searches and shuffles on a decline (partnerWithTrigger, docs/engine-gaps.md); the looter half is authorable

blocked.name: Leonin Shikari
blocked.why: No static letting equip abilities be activated at instant speed

blocked.name: Anger of the Gods
blocked.why: No turn-long 'if a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead' replacement keyed to the creatures this spell damaged

blocked.name: Voldaren Bloodcaster // Bloodbat Summoner
blocked.why: 'Whenever you create a Blood token' is keyed on the token's creator, which the engine doesn't record; an enters trigger isn't the same event

blocked.name: Lotus Vale
blocked.why: No entry replacement that sacrifices two untapped lands instead or else puts the land into the graveyard (Mox Diamond's discard form is unbuilt too)

blocked.name: Time Spiral
blocked.why: No effect shuffling each player's hand and graveyard into their library (the self-exile and 'untap up to six lands' are expressible)

blocked.name: Sigarda's Splendor
blocked.why: No per-permanent noted life total, set as it enters and re-noted on each upkeep trigger's resolution, for the draw condition to compare against

blocked.name: Sicarian Infiltrator
blocked.why: Squad (pay {2} any number of times as an additional cost, that many token copies on entering) isn't modeled

blocked.name: Sudden Substitution
blocked.why: No exchange of control, and none between a spell on the stack and a creature (then the spell's controller choosing new targets)
